features.name: signInScenario_email+password
features.reason: SelfAsserted-LocalAccountSignin-Email sets setting.operatingMode=Email and the LocalAccountSignUpWithLogonEmail technical profile collects email + newPassword/reenterPassword. Validation uses login-NonInteractive (ROPC) against AAD.
features.recommendation: Email + password sign-in/sign-up is fully supported in Microsoft Entra External ID. Migration path is straightforward.

features.name: signInScenario_reconsenting
features.reason: ProfileEdit user journey allows users to update givenName/surname via SelfAsserted-ProfileUpdate; profile-edit screens map to Entra External ID's profile-editing user flows.
features.recommendation: Profile editing is supported through Entra External ID user flows. No code changes required.

features.name: sessionControl_timeBased
features.reason: Refresh-token revocation journey uses AssertDateTimeIsGreaterThan ClaimsTransformation comparing refreshTokenIssuedOnDateTime against refreshTokensValidFromDateTime to enforce time-based session validity. Custom session-management semantics are not directly available in External ID.
features.recommendation: Time-based refresh-token revocation logic should be reimplemented using External ID's Custom Authentication Extensions (token issuance start).

migrationWarnings: Refresh-token validity is gated on a custom date-time comparison (AssertRefreshTokenIssuedLaterThanValidFromDate). External ID does not expose the same session-management primitive; equivalent logic must be reintroduced via a Custom Authentication Extension.
quickWins: Email and password sign-in/sign-up is fully supported in Microsoft Entra External ID with no additional configuration.
Profile-edit user journey maps cleanly to External ID's profile-edit user flow.
migrationSummary.overallRecommendation: Core authentication is supported. Session-based access-control logic (refresh-token revocation) requires Custom Authentication Extensions.
